description: After a year and a half with Lhoopa, I joined Evelan, a German IT company based in Hamburg, as a remote Software Engineer. I mainly worked on PAUL360, a full-stack Next.js, tRPC and Prisma platform. I built full-stack web applications, shipped new features on existing products, maintained and debugged several apps and APIs, and wrote unit and integration tests for every feature I added — all while collaborating closely with other developers and designers. Working remotely with the latest technologies was a dream setup, and the higher bar pushed me to grow a lot as an engineer.
